gloss: person without a fulfilling offline life

definitions.gloss: person whose real (offline) life is not fulfilling
definitions.explanation: Internet slang for someone whose real, offline life — especially their social or romantic life — is not satisfying. The negation of {リア充|りあじゅう}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{非|ひ}リア{充|じゅう}だ。
examples.english: My real life isn't much fun (I'm a hiriajuu).

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧{非|ひ}リア{充|じゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Plenty of "hiriajuu" spend their weekends at home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{非|ひ}リア{充|じゅう}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ネタ→ネタ：06309_neta⟧にして⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some people joke about being "hiriajuu" at their own expense.

notes:
USAGE: {非|ひ}リア{充|じゅう} is internet slang, formed by prefixing ⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧ (non-, un-) to ⟦{リア充|りあじゅう}→リア充：06460_riajuu⟧ (a person with a fulfilling offline life). It is used self-deprecatingly or jokingly online.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{リア充|りあじゅう}→リア充：06460_riajuu⟧: person with a fulfilling real life — the direct antonym
- ⟦{陰|いん}キャ→陰キャ：06441_inkya⟧: introverted, gloomy type — overlapping slang, but about personality
